review_notes: Reviewed all of GraphBorel.lean and the graph and subgraph definitions it characterizes in Definitions.lean. Checked Mathlib’s Relation.ReflTransGen definition and related API: FiniteReach is an auxiliary bounded-path representation used to establish measurability, with an explicit equivalence to ReflTransGen, rather than a competing public closure concept. The finite-set characterization is private proof support, and the measurable-set declarations are useful wrappers/specializations. I found no concrete duplication cost that justifies a finding under this rubric.
